steps.title: Phase 1: the secure channel
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `more flash:vpn-plan.txt`. In `conf t`: `crypto isakmp policy 10`, then `encryption aes 256`, `hash sha256`, `authentication pre-share`, `group 14`, `exit`. Then the key from the plan: `crypto isakmp key <key> address 203.0.113.50`.

steps.title: Phase 2: protect the data
steps.body: `crypto ipsec transform-set GRID-TS esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac`, `exit`. Interesting traffic: `access-list 120 permit ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.50.0 0.0.0.255`. Then `crypto map GRID-MAP 10 ipsec-isakmp` with `set peer 203.0.113.50`, `set transform-set GRID-TS`, `match address 120`, `exit`. Apply it to the outside: `interface g0/2`, `crypto map GRID-MAP`.

steps.title: Bring it up and prove it
steps.body: The tunnel waits for interesting traffic. `end`, then `ping 192.168.50.10 source g0/1` (from the Northwatch LAN side). Check `show crypto isakmp sa` and `show crypto ipsec sa`. Last question: OSPF can't run through plain IPsec. What do you wrap it in? `submit WRAP=...`

objectives.label: Interesting traffic brought the tunnel up
